status: implemented (fullft13); CPU FP64 checks pass; GPU checks staged in the canaries
declared_as: bidirectional global attention with causal local attention (B); the causal control is C. Fully bidirectional local layers are NOT tested (a later, separately identified intervention).

C.global: same_document AND valid_query AND valid_key AND key_position <= query_position
C.local: global causal condition AND query_position - key_position < W

B.local: identical to C's causal local window

layer_type_rule: global iff the attention module's sliding_window is None (checked against module.is_sliding); never inferred from row length: a local layer whose W >= L stays causal under B
documents: documents from position_ids (a new document wherever the position does not advance by 1); every layer, including shared-KV layers, masks by document; positions reset per document
padding: rejected in the optimised packed path (a materialised or padding mask raises); packed rows only

implementation.single_document_rows: one SDPA call, is_causal = not (B and global), no mask
implementation.packed_or_windowed: query chunks (default 2,048); keys = window/document range (C) or the chunk's documents, past and future (B); a [B, chunk, keys] boolean mask, never [L, L]
implementation.kv_heads: K / V expanded to the query heads (repeat_kv) so the fused memory-efficient kernel applies at head_dim 512
implementation.cuda_kernels: SDPA restricted to efficient / flash; the math kernel is refused (JEV_ALLOW_SDPA_MATH=1 = explicit recorded override); an ineligible call raises
implementation.chunked_math: an explicit alternative implementation (--attn-impl chunked_math), same contract, tested

policy_transport.feature_extraction: fullft_train.py --extract-features (refuses an export whose policy differs or is unstated)
policy_transport.serving: release/garas_vbll/garas_vbll_engine.py reads the export's policy; refuses B with a stock attention implementation; fullft_mem.require_policy after load
policy_transport.absent: a config without the attribute is the legacy causal policy C (fullft <= v12)

reference.dense: fullft_mem.dense_reference_attention (attn_implementation jev_dense_ref): explicit [B, L, L] mask + explicit softmax, refuses L > 4,096
reference.stock_causal: the pinned transformers implementation (sdpa with its own causal / sliding masks)

tolerances_frozen.argmax_changes: every change listed with its top-2 gap; near ties within 1e-3 documented, others invalidate

known_numerical_findings: torch's CPU flash-attention kernel returns gradients off by ~1e-7 relative (FP64) on packed rows of shared-KV stacks while its forward matches exactly; the CPU checks pin the SDPA math kernel (== the dense reference to 1e-12); the CUDA kernels are measured on p8 (sdv1_gpucheck.py)
transformers' eager attention upcasts its softmax to fp32, so it is not an FP64 reference; the stock causal reference is its sdpa path
